name: add
what it does: left + right (base-36 glyph arithmetic)

name: subtract
what it does: |right - left|

name: clock
what it does: frame / rate mod modulo

name: delay
what it does: bangs every rate x modulo frames

name: east
what it does: moves east one cell a frame; bangs when blocked

name: north
what it does: moves north one cell a frame; bangs when blocked

name: south
what it does: moves south one cell a frame; bangs when blocked

name: west
what it does: moves west one cell a frame; bangs when blocked

name: if
what it does: bangs when left and right are the same glyph

name: generator
inputs: left 3 = x, left 2 = y, left 1 = length; cells on the right
what it does: copies the cells on its right to the offset

name: halt
what it does: stops the operator below from running

name: increment
what it does: adds step to the value below, mod modulo

name: jumper
what it does: copies the glyph above to below

name: jymper
what it does: copies the glyph on its left to its right

name: konkat
inputs: left = count; variable names on the right
what it does: reads that many variables, writes their values below

name: lesser
what it does: the smaller of left and right

name: multiply
what it does: left x right

name: read
what it does: the cell at that offset

name: push
inputs: left 2 = key, left 1 = length, right = value
what it does: writes the value into one cell of a row below, keyed

name: query
inputs: left 3 = x, left 2 = y, left 1 = length
what it does: copies that many cells from the offset to below

name: random
what it does: a random value in the range

name: track
inputs: left 2 = key, left 1 = length; cells on the right
what it does: picks one of the cells on its right (the picked cell is lit)

name: uclid
what it does: Euclidean rhythm bangs

name: variable
inputs: left = name to write, right = value (or name to read)
what it does: writes or reads a variable

name: write
inputs: left 2 = x, left 1 = y, right = value
what it does: writes the value at the offset

name: lerp
what it does: moves the value below toward the target

name: bang
what it does: a one-frame bang, then disappears

name: comment
what it does: stops the rest of the row (up to the next #)

name: passive
what it does: a lowercase operator only runs when banged (as in Orca)

name: probability
what it does: passes a bang below at random

name: phase clock
inputs: left rate (default 1), right length (default 4), above = step (default 0)
what it does: bangs on that step of the cycle

name: burst
what it does: when banged, plays that many bangs one frame x div / mul apart, in real time

name: mute block
what it does: each bang hashes the block out with # or brings it back

name: scale
inputs: left = variable name (default 0), right 12 cells = 1 / 0 for C C# D ... B (default C major)
what it does: defines a scale for ) and ]

name: udp
what it does: Seaflake's UDP message (Pilot): kept so patches load, sends nothing on the module

name: osc
what it does: Seaflake's OSC message: kept so patches load, sends nothing on the module

name: note
inputs: channel 0-f, octave 0-8, note, velocity (default f), length in frames (default 1)
what it does: note on through the Disting EX's MIDI out; note off when the length is up

name: mono note
what it does: a new note on the channel cuts the old one

name: CC
what it does: control change

name: pitch bend
what it does: pitch bend (the EX.M.CH channel is put back after)

name: just note
what it does: a bend to the just-intonation ratio, the note, then the bend is reset

name: scale note
inputs: channel, octave, degree (1-based), scale variable (from +), velocity, length
what it does: the note at that degree of the scale

name: shaped note
inputs: channel, octave, note, velocity, shape 1-4, repeats, duration in frames, pulse width
what it does: a run of notes spaced by the shape, in real time
